concepts.title: Limits
concepts.summary: What a function approaches as its input approaches a value.
objectives: Estimate a limit from a table of values.
Explain why a limit can exist where the function is not defined.

concepts.title: The derivative as a limit
concepts.summary: The slope of a curve at a point, defined as the limit of the slopes of chords.
objectives: Compute a derivative from the limit definition for a simple polynomial.
Interpret a derivative as a rate of change.
reasons: The derivative is defined as a limit.

concepts.title: Differentiation rules
concepts.summary: The power, sum, and product rules that make differentiation quick.
objectives: Apply the power rule and the sum rule to a polynomial.
reasons: The rules are shortcuts for the limit definition.
